status_of_this_document: POST HOC revision, declared 12 Oct 2026 before any study run under version 2. It revises ONLY the gaussian implied-SD identity of the ANOM verification. Protocol v1 (config/anomaly_history_validation_protocol.json) is not edited and still governs every parameter, reference, comparison, tolerance and every other check. Runs made before this revision keep their own recorded statuses: anomhist_20261004_141846_28bd and run_20261012_114559_4737 keep ANOM_VERIFICATION_STATUS=FAIL in their own records.

author_decision.decision: revise the ANOM scale identity check, post hoc

extends_protocol.scope: everything except the gaussian implied-SD identity is taken from v1 unchanged; protocol v2 refuses to load if this file has changed

post_hoc_reason: The v1 identity row 'gaussian standardised_effect: implied SD(outcome) constant within each outcome' is evaluated within groups of equal n (R/daily_layer.R .siw_dl_identities splits by n; R/cold_burden.R siw_cold_identities). It assumes that rows with the same n share one complete-case sample. The declared post hoc diagnostic (validation/ANOM_SAMPLE_SD_DIAGNOSTIC_DECLARATION.md, validation/anom_sample_sd_diag.R) showed that this premise is false for the study data: two different complete-case samples of size 54 exist, so equal n does not imply the same sample and the by-n constancy row fails although every row's scale fields are internally consistent.

evidence.direct_vs_implied_sd: the directly measured SD of each row's own complete-case sample equals the implied SD to <= 7.5e-15 (relative)
evidence.complete_case_sets: the two n = 54 sets differ by one participant each

rule_v2.check: gaussian standardised_effect: implied SD(outcome) equals the directly measured SD of the row's own complete-case sample
rule_v2.applies_to: every COMPLETED gaussian ANOM row (both reference definitions, every metric-method, both burdens, every window), in the package results and in the frozen reference table
rule_v2.direct_sd: stats::sd(y[mask]) for the row's outcome y
rule_v2.mask: the traced complete-case mask of validation/anom_sample_sd_diag.R (asd_masks): mask = tier_ok & is.finite(y) & is.finite(x); tier_ok = stats::complete.cases(siw_tier_matrix(dat, config$tiers[[parameters.tier]])); x = siw_anomaly_features(siw_anomaly_values(dat, config, protocol_v1, reference_definition)$metrics[[metric]][[anomaly_method]], parameters.min_available_fraction)[[burden_direction]][, window_or_lag]; dat = siw_prepare_data(<canonical CSV>)
rule_v2.relative_difference: |implied_sd - direct_sd| / |direct_sd| (the identity's own scaling; 0 when |implied_sd - direct_sd| <= 1e-300)
fails_when: a row has no traced mask (its key cannot be traced)
the traced mask size differs from the recorded n
the implied or the direct SD is not finite

v1_identity_kept: The v1 by-n row is still computed with the unchanged code and reported as 'V1 identity (superseded, kept for the record)'. It is never silently removed; it no longer enters ANOM_VERIFICATION_STATUS_V2.

statuses.ANOM_VERIFICATION_STATUS: the v1 composition, unchanged; still computed and shown for the record (superseded)
statuses.ANOM_VERIFICATION_STATUS_V2: the v1 components with the v1 by-n implied-SD row replaced by rule_v2 (package and frozen); governs the ANOM verification of runs made under this protocol

near_zero_scaling_recorded.note: previously code-only (R/anomaly_history.R); recorded here explicitly; unchanged

checks.check: independent anomaly values (siw_anomaly_values_verify): stable and zero-safe anomalies and their diagnostics
checks.reason: anomalies are on a unit scale; a value that is zero up to rounding must not give an unbounded ratio

checks.check: window features (siw_anomaly_features_verify): vectorised vs literal per-participant feature
checks.reason: a mean of anomalies that cancels to zero up to rounding must not give an unbounded ratio

unchanged: No other check, tolerance, reference, parameter, multiplicity family or status rule changes.
public_build_note: PUBLIC BUILD: every SHA-256, size and location of the accepted input and of the frozen references is replaced by REDACTED_PUBLIC_BUILD; the full declaration is held in the private validation kit.
